product_overview: NixgoFood is a customer ordering experience for El Taca Nijo that lets users browse menu items, customize products, manage a cart, choose pickup or delivery, and place demo orders. After checkout, users can track their order status on a dedicated order page.
core_goals: Browse the menu and filter items by category
View product details and customize items before adding them to the cart
Adjust cart contents and review pricing before checkout
Choose pickup or delivery for fulfillment
Enter customer details and place an order in demo mode
Track the placed order through its status updates

features.name: Catalog Navigation and Category Filter
features.description: Customers can browse the menu on the home page and narrow products by category while reviewing item names, descriptions, and prices.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a category filter -> See the product list update to matching items -> Review product names, descriptions, and prices
Navigate to / -> Switch between different category filters -> Observe the displayed products change accordingly -> Confirm the menu matches the selected category

features.name: Product Detail Modal and Modifiers
features.description: Customers can open a product to review details, choose required and optional modifiers, see the price update, and add the customized item to the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a product from the catalog -> Select the required modifier options -> Toggle any optional modifier choices -> Observe the total price update -> Add the customized product to the cart
Navigate to / -> Open a product from the catalog -> Try to add it without choosing a required option -> Remain on the product detail view until the required selection is made
Navigate to / -> Open a product from the catalog -> Change modifier selections -> Observe the price recalculate before adding the item to the cart

features.name: Cart Drawer and Quantity Adjustments
features.description: Customers can review items in the cart, change quantities, remove items, and confirm the subtotal before checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the cart drawer -> Review the items and subtotal -> Increase or decrease item quantities -> Observe the subtotal recalculate
Navigate to / -> Open the cart drawer -> Reduce an item quantity until it reaches zero -> See the item removed from the cart -> Confirm the cart count updates
Navigate to / -> Open the cart drawer -> Review the updated item totals -> Confirm the cart subtotal reflects the current contents

features.name: Pickup Delivery Method Selection
features.description: Customers can choose pickup as the fulfillment method and see delivery fees removed from the total.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the cart drawer -> Select pickup as the fulfillment method -> See the delivery fee change to $0.00 -> Confirm the total equals the subtotal
Navigate to / -> Open the checkout flow -> Select pickup as the fulfillment method -> Review the order summary with no delivery fee applied

features.name: Delivery Method and Leaflet Map Location Picker
features.description: Customers can choose delivery, select a location on the map, and review the calculated distance and delivery fee before continuing.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the cart drawer -> Select delivery as the fulfillment method -> Choose a location on the map -> Confirm the location selection -> See the delivery distance and zone fee applied
Navigate to / -> Open the cart drawer -> Select delivery as the fulfillment method -> Drag the map marker to a new location -> Review the updated distance and delivery fee
Navigate to / -> Open the cart drawer -> Select delivery as the fulfillment method -> Click a point on the map -> Confirm the selected address area and delivery charge

features.name: Checkout and Demo Order Placement
features.description: Customers can enter their contact details and submit an order in demo mode, which creates an order and takes them to tracking.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Fill in customer name, phone number, and optional notes -> Submit the order -> See the redirect to /order/[id]
Navigate to /checkout -> Fill in customer details -> Review the order summary -> Submit the order -> Arrive at the order tracking page

features.name: Simulated Order Tracking
features.description: Customers can open the order page to review order details and watch the status progress through the delivery timeline.
user_flows: Navigate to /order/[id] -> Review the order items, delivery address, and current status -> Observe the status timeline update from received to preparing to ready to on_the_way to delivered
Navigate to /order/[id] -> Check the order summary and tracking information -> Watch the order status change over time
